common_name: Eastern woodland sedge / common wood sedge
look_here_first: Woodland Carex with relatively broad, flat green leaves and a loose set of separate spikes: one terminal staminate spike above several pistillate spikes.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Cyperaceae/Carex: grasslike perennial sedges with sheathing leaves; Carex fruits are enclosed in a perigynium, a key structure for species-level identification.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flat leaves, often noticeably broader than cedar sedge

lookalikes.differences: Compared with C. planostachys, C. blanda usually has broader flatter leaves and taller looser foliage. Compared with C. edwardsiana, it lacks the strongly purple-red culm bases and Central Texas canyon-endemic pattern.
